widgets_values:
I find these default settings best but if the previous scene has more motion, try increasing context frames or ref ramp
** note: context frames are in latent frames so 1 = roughly 24 decoded frames**

Default: 2 context_frames, increasing this pulls more context but may be slower.


pin_last_frame will use the last frame of the prior video as a start frame. use "first_frame" input if you want to override this (i.e. start the extended with with a novel view)
